children: Hecate Energy and EGH confirm resolution of lender-related matters and expect the business combination to close in early Q1 2027.
EGH and Hecate resolved legal and documentation issues with Hecate’s lenders, removing an overhang on the de-SPAC process.
The transaction values Hecate at a pre-money enterprise value of ~$1.2 billion and aims for a Nasdaq listing under ticker HCTE.
Parties now expect the business combination to close in early Q1 2027, subject to customary approvals including EGH shareholder vote.
Hecate is in talks with potential interim investors to strengthen its balance sheet and support pipeline development ahead of closing.

title: Hecate Energy and EGH confirm resolved lender issues, business combination on track for Q1 2027
